content_identity.method: sha256 over sorted records of "path\0mode\0sha256(file bytes)" for every tracked file, EXCLUDING PUBLIC_PROVENANCE.json itself
content_identity.why_self_excluded: A file cannot contain its own hash. The excluded file is bound instead by the signed release tag.
content_identity.recompute: python3 - <<'EOF'  (see docs; algorithm is fully specified above)
content_identity.warning: A digest over file NAMES alone does not bind content and must not be used. An earlier revision of this lane made exactly that error.

commit_binding.rationale: This file is inside the tree it describes, so it cannot state the commit or tree id of the commit that contains it without regress. The commit/tree binding is provided by the SIGNED RELEASE TAG, which is created only after the release gate passes. Until a signed tag exists, treat the commit binding as ABSENT, not as implied.
